title: Somatosensory population co-smoothing
disposition_reason: A substantive tensor preparation/scoring component exists for complete 826-row/65-unit Area 2 training-asset inputs, but it does not read or authenticate NWB conversion. Active/perturbed reporting is implemented; leave-condition-out generalization is not frozen.

scientific_target.question: How well do visible somatosensory neurons predict withheld spikes during active and perturbed reaches, evaluated separately under the same frozen preparation and split?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed held-out-unit spike counts on fixed 600 msmovement-onset windows for the declared evaluation rows.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Area 2_Bump Han 2017-12-07 training NWB; actual counts, heldout flags and ctr_hold_bump source values must be authenticated by the operator conversion.
scientific_target.case_unit: Whole movement-onset-aligned reach or perturbation trial; train/eval membership held by continuous block.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One Han macaque in one recording session;65 units and 826 source trials are nested observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Condition-stratified spike prediction within one session. Reporting both conditions does not itself test active-to-passive transfer or intervention causality.
exclusions: Leave-condition-out generalization until a fixed assignment is explicitly implemented.
True latent-rate recovery from observed-count likelihood.
New animal, hidden-test or complete native acquisition qualification.

inputs: Preparation requires all 826 source trial rows and 65 units, including explicit exclusions; fixed 600 mswindow[-100,500)ms at 5 or 20 msbins.
Public training exposes visible and withheld counts; public query exposes visible counts, opaque IDs, explicit unit axes, relative grid,spikes_per_bin units and packet digest.
forbidden_inputs: Query withheld counts, source trial IDs, absolute times, ctr_hold_bump and movement/condition labels in public projections.
Candidate-selected exclusions, masks or unit ordering.
observation_contract.case_identity: Generated opaque IDs are bound to complete source metadata/count bytes; query IDs and heldout-unit IDs must match in order. Native source IDs and actual masks are not yet authenticated by this component.
observation_contract.split: Operator must freeze native-split-to-train/eval/excluded roles. Every continuous block has one role and train/eval windows cannot overlap. Both active and perturbed evaluation rows required; no automatic leave-condition-out split is claimed.
observation_contract.coverage: All 826 rows/65 units of the named training asset are retained in preparation; all declared included query rows and fixed withheld units are scored. Separate test NWB is outside this component; public test-target release prevents untouched-holdout claims.

primary.name: active_and_perturbed_Poisson_co_bps
primary.aggregation: Two condition-specific pooled likelihood scores; recompute the per-unit evaluation-mean null separately within each condition. Keep both endpoints, do not collapse to a favorable condition.
primary.rationale: Measures prediction in both source conditions without conflating unequal spike totals or a pooled null with condition-wise performance.

secondary: Pooled official-equation co-bps as a separate diagnostic, not average of subgroup scores.
Signed differences versus training-mean and source-derived smoothing/Poisson controls; condition trial/unit support.

comparators.name: training_mean
comparators.procedure: Implemented training per-unit mean predictor; distinct from evaluation-derived metric null.

comparators.name: nlb_smoothing_poisson
comparators.inputs: Training visible/withheld counts and query visible counts only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented source-derived 30 ms Gaussian/log-count features and PoissonRegressor(alpha 0.01) per withheld unit with native integer-bin recipe; failed convergence/missing input is explicit.

nuisance_controls: Use exact source heldout mask and ctr_hold_bump 0 active/1 perturbed mapping; authentication remains required.
Separate continuous train/eval blocks and nonoverlapping windows.
Preserve missingness/exclusions independent of predictions and all heldout-unit coverage per condition.
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive complete-trial/block comparisons in one session; cannot obtain independent animal replication by resampling units or bins.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject extra fields, wrong masks/IDs/units, malformed outputs or uncovered condition units. Finite nonnegative rates required; exact zeros become 1e-9 as in pinned official metric, unlike 017/018 strict positivity. All-zero target totals are explicitly undefined.

implementation.scorer_target: Genuine held-out spike counts supplied in a complete source tensor; native metadata are operator attestations and are not certified by matching shape/hash.
implementation.delivered_scope: Executable prepare/score/mean-reference/smoothing-reference functions and generated official-metric controls; no native NWB reader or candidate execution loop.
missing: Authenticate native NWB conversion, official mask, condition labels and physical time grid.
Resolve prospective active/passive split scope before outcomes and freeze the full packet.
Run authentic references and independently check them under actual allowed inputs.
implementation.execution_evidence: Documented 22-test generated controls include pinned organizer parity; no authentic native campaign or model result was produced by that component or by this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed per-trial numerical counts or fixed raster with all required time×withheld-unit expected counts; no no-tools participant transport is supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Any future direct arm must receive exactly the selected permitted observation and calibrated units, with no decoder, Python, source lookup, target or score access.
missing: Freeze a feasible complete per-case observation and response representation without silently changing the target.
Deliver and qualify a no-tools transport and complete answer collector before a direct-understanding claim.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed raster/time-window inspection of the same selected neural observations; no viewer is delivered for this registration.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only admitted rendered views; raw numerical/model operations would belong to the tool-assisted condition. Query targets and source identities remain inaccessible.
missing: Implement task-specific renderer, restricted actions and complete responses.
Verify rendered observations preserve required time/unit information and run a separately identified viewer evaluation.

tool_assisted.representation: Only an external numerical investigation could currently produce the submission; the artifact scorer does not supply a case-adaptive participant loop.
tool_assisted.boundary: Match observations, calibration, decoder access and cumulative compute against the fixed programme; freeze shared preparation, reset case state and prevent target/score feedback.
missing: Deliver a bounded per-case participant loop with authenticated observation and answer lineage.

frozen_program.representation: The current package accepts prediction artifacts or provides reference routines; it does not deliver the candidate programme lifecycle.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze source, fitting, selection and permitted query adaptation before assessment access; authentic target custody and runtime qualification remain external.
missing: Recover or implement the candidate producer and fit/freeze/predict/close lifecycle before calling the artifact score a programme evaluation.

summary: Replace ambiguous leave-condition-out wording with implemented both-condition reporting and an explicitly unresolved transfer assignment.
Retain complete 826 row/65 unit preparation coverage while marking native attestation and conversion gaps.
Define two primary condition-wise likelihood endpoints and distinguish official zero handling from 017/018.
